scope: Development diagnostic only. No H1/H2, formal candidate freeze, controller, gate/status change or Phase B.

training.recipe: Same scratch four-channel ResNet-18, clean depth and row/uniform objective as roi_dev. Same shuffled eligible exposures, 270 frozen Phase A train episodes. Use the clean 640 tip estimate, same pixel center and field of view; keep the native 384x384 HD crop without pooling. Fail if native and 640 eligibility differ from the previous Phase A cache.

cohort.pose: Each consecutive block of four new dev indices uses the parent sampler's initial ECM target from its first index. All four keep their own seeds, use only registered cap/target values, native HD twin enabled, no auxiliary deltas.
cohort.boundary: The conditions select registered parameters, not structural outputs. The labels are the observed structural rows. No reruns or force-to-label. Retain refusals and FAILED, including any budget-detected overcuts. Unmodified truth controller and guards. Initial and per-frame ECM camera pose matching is audited, not assumed. Cutter trajectory, deformation and number of bites need not match.

validation.frozen_dev_rule: For each arm predict the maximum probability row only above the largest false endpoint confidence among localizable frames on the old 30 Phase A validation trajectories; if none, accept every localizable image. New cohort only applies this rule; never select a confidence on the new cohort. Uncalibrated probabilities, clean depth only.
validation.report: Report all exposures and first localizable-or-not occurrence of each observed 8/9/10/11/12 mm row per trajectory (never select by localization). Also report support and endpoint outcomes by matched camera block. Missing phase labels do not become negative exposures; preserve pre-sheet rules. Force abstention for invalid locator. No formal acceptance call.
